name: SummaryList
description: Questions and their answers as a description list, one row per question with an optional action: for checking answers before submitting and for showing a submitted record.

keyboard: Not interactive itself; row actions are reached with Tab in reading order.
ariaRequirements: Renders a <dl>; each row is a <dt> label and a <dd> value, and an optional <dd> action.
Row actions should name what they change ("Change" plus a visually hidden label).

forbiddenUse: squeeze answers into columns side by side; one row per question.
use it for tables of several values per row.

layout.description:
"auto" stacks the label above the value in narrow containers and puts
them side by side once the list is wide enough (about 40rem).
